obligations.name: jointly_reacted_messages
obligations.description: Messages in core-infra that received a thumbsup reaction from both Priya and Łukasz on the same message.

task_spec.text: Identify which messages in the core-infra channel were reacted to by both Priya and Łukasz using the thumbsup emoji.

access_plan: Actor U01AGENBOT9 is already a member of core-infra (C_INFRA), so conversations.history retrieves the channel's messages and reactions.get/message_reactions data surfaces each message's reactors and emoji; cross-referencing with users.info for Priya (U_PRIYA) and Łukasz (U_LUKAS) confirms identity, letting the agent find messages where both appear as thumbsup reactors versus channel-mismatched or emoji-mismatched candidates.
